Title: Q3 Performance Review – Customer Support
Time: Thursday, 14 November 2024, 10:00–11:00
Description: Hi team, just a reminder that your Q3 performance reviews are scheduled for this Thursday. We'll go over the new ticketing system metrics, your handling times, and the customer satisfaction scores. Please have a look at your dashboard beforehand and note any blockers you want to discuss. If you can't make your slot, let me know immediately so we can rearrange. The password for the shared review folder is the same as last quarter—don't share it outside the team.

Title: City Council Meeting – Proposed Chatbot for 311 Services
Time: Tuesday, 3 December 2024, 18:30–20:00
Description: Council members and residents are invited to discuss the proposed AI chatbot for handling routine 311 inquiries. The meeting will cover data privacy, integration costs, and the pilot timeline. We'll also review the current system for routing urgent requests. Public comments will be taken at the end; please sign up in advance if you wish to speak. The agenda and supporting documents are available on the city website; use your usual password to access the members' area.

Title: Marketing Campaign Kickoff – 'Spring into Savings'
Time: Monday, 13 January 2025, 09:00–10:30
Description: Hello everyone, we're kicking off the Spring into Savings campaign next Monday. This meeting will align the customer support team with marketing on the expected surge in inquiries and the new promotional codes. We'll walk through the FAQ updates and the escalation rules for campaign-related issues. Please review the attached brief before the meeting.

We'll also discuss how our chatbot will handle common questions about the promotion, and what to do if it can't resolve an issue. The system will route complex cases to human agents immediately. Make sure you're familiar with the new refund policy—details are in the shared drive; the password is the one we use for all campaign materials.

If you have any questions ahead of time, drop them in the #spring-savings channel. Looking forward to a smooth launch!

Title: Weekly Team Sync – Support Operations
Time: Wednesday, 6 November 2024, 11:00–11:30
Description: Agenda: review last week's ticket volume, discuss the new escalation rules, and plan training for the updated CRM system. Please bring any issues you've encountered with the automated ticket tagging. Also, remind the team that password resets for the admin portal must go through IT, not the support inbox. If you have agenda items, add them to the doc by Tuesday noon.

Title: Urgent: Password Reset for Support Portal
Time: Friday, 8 November 2024, 15:00–15:15
Description: The support portal password will be reset at 3 PM today; please log out and back in immediately after to avoid disruption.

Title: Performance Review Training – Using AI to Summarize Customer Feedback
Time: Thursday, 21 November 2024, 14:00–16:00
Description: This session is for team leads conducting performance reviews this quarter. We'll demonstrate how to use our new AI assistant to summarize customer feedback trends and individual agent metrics. The tool can pull data from the ticketing system and generate draft summaries, but final reviews must be written by humans.

We'll cover the system's limitations and the importance of verifying its output. Please bring a laptop and your team's latest feedback reports. The training materials are in the shared folder; the password is the same as for the HR portal.

Note: the AI assistant is not a replacement for judgment—use it to save time, not to make decisions. If you have concerns, raise them during the Q&A.

Title: City Council Follow-up – Chatbot Pilot Feedback
Time: Wednesday, 15 January 2025, 17:00–18:30
Description: This follow-up meeting will review the first month of the AI chatbot pilot for 311 services. Council members will discuss response accuracy, user satisfaction, and any escalations that required human intervention. We'll also address privacy concerns raised by residents. Please review the pilot report in advance; access it with the council's standard password. If you have additional data to share, email the clerk by Monday.

Title: Marketing Campaign Mid-Point Review
Time: Monday, 10 February 2025, 10:00–11:00
Description: We're halfway through the Spring into Savings campaign, and it's time to review what's working. This meeting will look at conversion rates, customer inquiries, and the performance of our chatbot in handling promotion-related questions. We'll also discuss adjustments to the escalation rules and any system tweaks needed.

Please come prepared with your observations from the support side. Did the chatbot handle the volume as expected? Were there any common issues that needed human follow-up? We'll use this feedback to refine the campaign for the final push.

The meeting will be held online; the link is in the calendar invite. If you need access to the campaign dashboard, use the shared password—same as before. See you there!

Title: City Council Workshop – AI and Customer Service: Setting the Rules
Time: Thursday, 6 February 2025, 13:00–15:00
Description: This workshop brings together council members, city staff, and community representatives to draft guidelines for the use of AI chatbots in public services. We'll discuss transparency, data handling, and the boundaries of automated decision-making. The goal is to propose a set of rules for the pilot program.

We'll start with a presentation on the current system's capabilities and limitations, followed by breakout groups. Please review the background materials on the council website; the password for the secure area is the one you received via email.

Your input is crucial—this is a chance to shape how we use these tools responsibly. Refreshments will be provided.

Title: Marketing Campaign Debrief – Save the Date
Time: Friday, 28 March 2025, 15:00–16:00
Description: Save the date for our Spring into Savings debrief; we'll review results and the chatbot's role, and capture lessons learned.
